# Intervention results (generated by scripts/make_tables.py from logs/protocol_*.json)

One row per model and site. Rates are model-relative and computed on matched pairs on which the model's own decisions differ. The column `nec` is the fraction of pairs whose decisions still differ after pair-mean ablation of S_rel, so lower is stronger necessity. The column `suff` is sufficiency: the fraction of pairs keeping their decision after complement interchange. `addR2` is the additive R² of the S_rel coordinates. Surrogate columns give (accuracy, pair_flip) after replacing the S_rel coordinates; `exact` is the reference. `path` reports MLP-path versus direct-path IIA. `manifold` is the patched-state nearest-neighbour distance divided by the natural nearest-neighbour distance.
